summary: A role with kind="relative_to", ref="ego", dsM=+G is placed BEHIND the ego about two thirds of the time, and when it is ahead the distance does not match G. This silently converts "a vehicle G metres ahead of the ego" into "a vehicle behind the ego that recedes for the whole clip".

reproduction.template: single role, kind=relative_to, ref=ego, dsM=param.initialGapM in [8,30], dLane=0
reproduction.method: direction-corrected: take sign of the ego own ds/dt over the first 60 ticks, then measure (other.s0 - ego.s0) * sign, restricted to ticks where both actors are on the SAME laneRsl

blastRadius.gateFailureShare: C2 (closest approach at spawn) = 29.3% of all traces, the single largest admission loss
blastRadius.medianC2: starts 9.4 m apart, ends 23.4 m apart
blastRadius.contrastPassing: passing traces start 19.2 m apart and end 0.5 m apart

suspectCode: materialize.ts:665-680 documents a KNOWN related hazard: the structural pass evaluates dsM as 0 because it is a site-dependent expression, so the lane chain is built too short and projectPoint silently CLAMPS to the route start. The backward-extension guard exists for the ego; the same clamp appears to hit relative_to roles, which would explain both the wrong sign and the uncorrelated magnitude.
whyItMattersForTheGoal: Requirement A needs ~45-55% admission to reach ~100 archetypes from 208 briefs. The current rate is ~32%, and this defect alone accounts for the largest single share of failures.
notedForVisualLane: This is invisible to a blind agent but obvious in one glance at a top-down render at t=0 — the challenger is plainly on the wrong side of the ego.
RETRACTED_CLAIM: An earlier version of this report claimed the challenger is placed BEHIND the ego ~2/3 of the time. That claim was FALSE and is retracted. It came from comparing lane stations `s` across actors; `s` restarts on each lane of a chain, so a challenger on a successor lane appears "behind" when it is not.
correctedFinding: Direction is CORRECT (aheadFrac 1.00, 43/43, geometric forward-projection test). DISTANCE is not honoured: requested mean 18.1 m (range 9-30) yields actual mean 8.9 m (range 1.4-19.5), correlation requested-vs-actual = 0.162.
correctMetric: project (other.pos - ego.pos) onto the ego heading unit vector at t=0; never compare lane `s`.
stillConsistentWith: projectPoint CLAMPING on a too-short lane chain (materialize.ts:665-680) — clamping compresses distance without reversing direction, which matches the evidence.
rootCauseLocalised: materialize.ts:1269 sampledFrameS() returns refFrameS + dsM for a relative_to role; materialize.ts framePoint(s) then calls this.refRoute.poseAt(s - frame.sRange[0]), and Route.poseAt CLAMPS when s exceeds the reference route. So any authored longitudinal offset beyond the reference route is silently compressed to the route end. coverTarget() is NOT the cause: it runs afterwards, on the already-clamped world point, and only extends the chain BACKWARDS anyway.

falsificationTests.gapBandSweep: requested [3,8] -> median actual 5.7 m (error 2.3 m); [8,15] -> 8.3 m (4.2 m); [25,40] -> 6.4 m (error 24.4 m). Accurate for small offsets, badly wrong for large ones.
falsificationTests.hardCeiling: maxInst is ~16-18 m in EVERY band tested, which is the reference-route length remaining ahead of the ego. This is the signature of a clamp, not of noise.
falsificationTests.upstreamRunwayAttempt: adding corridor runwayUpstreamM >= 120/160 made it WORSE (actors landed BEHIND, median -13.0 m) and collapsed matched sites from 51 to 7. Not the fix.

contributingAuthoringCause: the ego role spawns at pose.s = "0 - (clamp(0.7*lane.speedLimitKph,18,42))/3.6*8", a NEGATIVE site-dependent expression (~-62 m). materialize.ts:665-680 documents exactly this hazard: the structural pass evaluates such an expression as 0, so the chain is built too short and the real station clamps.
patchAttempted: I made coverTarget() extension symmetric (append successors when the projection clamps to the route END, not just prepend predecessors). tsc clean, but placement stayed capped at ~17 m, so it did NOT fix this. REVERTED - the tree is clean. Recording it so nobody re-attempts the same wrong fix.
consequence: Every authored "N metres ahead of the ego" collapses to ~9 m. Statistically linked to the dominant admission loss: C2 failures start a median 8.1 m ahead vs 11.0 m for passing traces (Mann-Whitney p=0.0001).
